question: What practical purpose does a merely figurative attribution of agency serve?
premises: A figurative usage of agency has no clear explanatory purpose.
A mere designation, even if unreal, can still be changed or replaced.
What can be altered without loss of reality does not establish real agency.
inference: Therefore, the figurative attribution of agency is explanatorily dispensable.
plain_english: What purpose is served by talk of agency if it is only figurative? Such a designation need not be real and can simply be changed.
